title: Impacted lower wisdom tooth and the nerve near it
risk: may get nerve damage after the whole tooth is taken out
may have nerve damage that does not go away

sentences: This is an impacted lower wisdom tooth.
Its roots wrap around a nerve.
Taking the tooth out can damage the nerve and make your lip and chin numb.
The red part is the nerve.
It gives feeling to the lower teeth, gums, lip and chin.
As the tooth comes out, the nerve can be pressed or cut.
The feeling often comes back, but sometimes it never does.
Rates vary, but about 7 in 100 may get nerve damage.
1 in 100 may have damage that does not go away.
For a tooth like this, it is a good idea to see a specialist (an oral surgeon) first.
